en: The Analysis of the Monastic Rules (Bhikkhuvibhaṅga), First Part.
Regarding the offenses for one who engages in sexual intercourse, to which of the four legal issues (*adhikaraṇa*) do they belong?
The offenses for one who engages in sexual intercourse belong to the legal issue of offenses (*āpattādhikaraṇa*) among the four legal issues... [and so forth].
For one who, out of disrespect, voids excrement, urine, or spittle in water, which of the four legal issues (*adhikaraṇa*) is this offense?
For one who, out of disrespect, voids excrement, urine, or spittle in water, the offense is a legal issue of an offense (*āpattādhikaraṇa*).
The sixth section on legal issues is concluded.
